about.title: About Nebulis
about.story1: I've always loved astronomy and astrophotography. In 2023 I bought a Seestar, and quickly ran into a wall: getting images off the device and organized was a slog of manual file copying and guesswork. I wrote a few scripts to handle it for myself, and those scripts kept growing until they turned into a full app.
about.story2: Nebulis is that app. It does the tedious part, pulling images off your telescope, organizing them, and matching them against catalogs, so you can spend more time observing and less time managing files.
about.feedbackBefore: Found a bug, or have an idea for a feature? Email
about.supportDescription: Nebulis is free and built in my spare time. If it's useful to you, a coffee is always appreciated.

addTelescopeModal.genericLayoutTitle: Generic SMB Layout: folder format the import expects
addTelescopeModal.genericLayoutIntro: For non-SeeStar / non-Dwarf shares, organize your files like this on the SMB share root:
addTelescopeModal.genericLayoutRule1: = catalog id (M31, NGC1788, IC1805) or a common name (Andromeda, Heart). Catalog ids resolve to better metadata.
addTelescopeModal.genericLayoutRule2: = YYYY-MM-DD_HHMM in local time. The date drives the calendar view; the time disambiguates multiple sessions in one night.
addTelescopeModal.genericLayoutRule3: at least one stacked or single image (.fit / .fits / .jpg / .png).
addTelescopeModal.genericLayoutRule4: used for quality scoring and per-frame review.
addTelescopeModal.genericLayoutRule5: JSON with exposureSec, gain, filter, frameCount, integrationSec. Anything missing is inferred from filenames or left blank.
addTelescopeModal.genericLayoutRule6: Filenames are flexible. Anything ending in a recognized extension under lights/ or subframes/ is picked up.
addTelescopeModal.genericLayoutFooter: The importer skips object folders with no lights/ subfolder, so partial uploads won't pollute your library.
addTelescopeModal.mergeBody: This device is already paired to your telescope {{name}}. Add this connection to it so files don't import twice.
addTelescopeModal.opticalConfigsSaveFirst: {{name}} has no fixed field of view Nebulis knows about. Save this telescope first, then reopen it from Edit to add one or more optical configurations (for example "Native" and "0.8x Reducer") for the Framing & Mosaic FOV preview.
addTelescopeModal.opticalConfigsHelp: No fixed field of view is known for this telescope. Add one entry per optical setup you actually use (for example "Native" and "0.8x Reducer") and pick which is mounted right now. The Framing & Mosaic preview uses whichever is active.
